description: v2 of the 20-case release gate over the deterministic demo corpus. Preserves every v1 case id, kind, hard flag, message, knowledge scope and answer point. Adds the explicit inline-citation contract for answer cases, the coverage-gap refusal contract for clear out-of-domain questions, the reviewed finite prohibition on the known case-10 unsupported inference, and self-contained memory citation/viewing constraints. v1 stays untouched; reports produced against v1 are not comparable with v2 pass rates.

kindRules.answer: 应在知识范围内作答，且回复正文必须包含可解析的行内引用（形如 [cite:证据ID]，指向命中的资料或 FAQ 标准答案）；仅有 references 列表不算满足
kindRules.refuse: 必须拒绝作答或明确承认覆盖缺口，绝不编造；问题清晰但知识库无覆盖时不得以泛泛澄清代替拒答
kindRules.memory-not-cited: 引用列表中绝不能出现长期记忆内容，记忆只可作为回答背景；所有者主动查看自己的长期记忆是允许的；无引用的转人工同样满足要求，且不要求引用资料

contract.prohibitedAssertionsPolicy: 只收录已审阅的有限表达，出现任一即判该 case 失败；该列表不构成通用语义证明，其他矛盾仍由 judge 复核

memoryConstraints.citationRule: 长期记忆正文绝不能出现在 references 列表中；记忆只可作为背景影响回答
memoryConstraints.viewingRule: 允许所有者主动查看自己的长期记忆，记忆查看本身不违规，也不因此要求引用文档

digest.canonicalization: SHA-256 over JSON.stringify({version, contract, rules, cases}) with object keys sorted recursively and no extra whitespace
